source: Gray Zone Warfare wiki (gray-zone-warfare.fandom.com): each item's own infobox, the penetration, speed and accuracy chart on its Ballistics page, the gear and medical overview tables where the infobox leaves a vendor, rank, material or use time blank, and the Weapons overview table where a gun's page leaves its fire rate or MOA blank. A few gear rows exist only in those tables, with no item page; they are listed from the table and marked table only.

rules.ammo: Tier is the highest armour class the round goes through reliably (rated 2, "usually ignores") on the wiki's Ballistics chart, which rates rounds at typical engagement distances: S through III++, A through III+, B through III, C through IIIA or IIIA+, D anything less. Inside a letter, the higher reliable class ranks first (IIIA+ above IIIA), then the round with more partial ratings against the classes above. Rounds still level after that share a rank (shown =n), grouped by caliber, fastest first.
rules.weapon: Punch is the tier of the best round on the gun's own wiki ammo list (plus any same-caliber round with its own page). With vendor levels ticked it is the best round you can buy at those levels. Two rounds level on the chart: the faster is named, the other follows "=". Inside a punch letter, the higher reliable class of that round ranks first, then more partial ratings above it, then the tighter MOA; a gun with no published MOA comes after those with one. Guns still level share a rank (=n). Meta is a published guide's opinion, not a stat: it has its own column and sort.
